rationale: The tape is dead at the lows — five near-flat 5m candles on shrinking volume (0.54x RVOL, $0.02 ATR) show neither continued distribution to justify a short nor any capitulation/reclaim to justify a bounce long, and price sitting exactly on the 9-EMA with a 20bp spread means the expected hour-of-day move is smaller than round-trip transaction costs. The session VWAP print ($12.16) is mechanically inconsistent with today's high ($11.15), so that field is unreliable and provides no anchor, and with no news, no borrow data, and no comparable historical setups, either direction is a coin flip net of costs. Skipping until a trigger appears (volume-backed break of $9.70 or a reclaim toward $9.90+).
